question: How are the impellers of the family designated in relation to the four ages?
premises: The term caturyuga is used as a designation.
The beings are called impellers of the family.
inference: The independent impellers of the family are designated in connection with the four ages.
uncertainties: The precise syntactic relation of caturyuga to the rest of the verse is unclear.
plain_english: O Lord, thus are the independent impellers of the family, called Caturyuga.
